description_text:
Game ready low-poly Kitchen Utensils models with PBR textures for game engines/renderers.
This product is intended for game/real time/background use. This model is not intended for subdivision. Renders done in Marmoset Toolbag 3. Default render in Blender will NOT look like the preview images. The Marmoset Toolbag scene is included.
The textures in the embedded Marmoset preview are somewhat compressed. The textures you get when you purchase this product have better quality.
||SPECS||

  - Geometry is triangulated to ensure best shading.

  - Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space.

  - All materials and objects named appropriately.

  - Scaled to approximate real world size.

  - Tested in Marmoset Toolbag 3(see renders).

  - Tested in Unreal Engine 4.

  - Tested in Unity Engine.

  - Unity and Unreal Engine 4 projects are included.

  - No special plugins needed.

  - .dae, .abc, .stl, .obj and .fbx versions exported from Blender 2.83.

|| Textures ||
4096x4096 textures:

  - General PBR Metallic/Roughness  textures: BaseColor, Metallic, Roughness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO.

  - Unity Textures: Albedo, MetallicSmoothness, Normal(OpenGL), AO.

  - Unreal Engine 4 textures: BaseColor, OcclusionRoughnessMetallic, Normal(DirectX).

  - PBR Specular/Glossiness textures: Diffuse, Specular, Glossiness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO.

All textures in png format. Also included clean variant of textures without damage.  Substance Painter source files also available in the extra downloads so that you can easily alter the textures as you wish with Substance Painter.

description_text:
A simple ceramic coffee mug created with Blender 2.73 and rendered in Cycles. In this file are three mugs in three different colors included. Yellow, red and blue.
YOU WANT A LOW POLY GAME READY VERSION OF THIS MODEL? JUST LET ME KNOW!
|| GEOMETRY ||
Clean geometry, quads only. No ngons!
|| TEXTURES ||
This model uses only one noise texture as a bumpmap for a slight displacement. The texture is generated with Cycles nodes itself.
|| MATERIALS ||
The coffee mug has 3 materials applied. A white ceramics on the inside, a colored ceramics on the outside and a natural rough ceramics on the bottom. All materials are created with nodes for Cycles Render. You can easily change the color of the mug by editing only one color value in the material node.
|| COMPOSITING ||
Compositing setup to render the model isolated from the environment with alpha values as background included.
|| RENDERS ||
  - renders created in Cycles Render at 1.000 samples using subsurf modifier level 2 - wireframe renders are showing the mesh without subsurf modifier
|| SCALE ||
The model is in real world size and scale.
X = 0,116m (Blender units) Y = 0,084m (Blender units) Z = 0,088m (Blender units)
|| EXPORTED FILES ||
This model was created with Blender. Only the blend file includes materials, textures and modifiers. All other formats have been exported and including only the mesh!
|| END ||

  - fbx - contains simplified materials

description_text:
Model of an old, worn and somewhat rusty enameled plate with 4K PBR-textures built to real-world scale (metric system).
The plate is a classic design inspired by the old enameled products of the Kockums brand, especially the yellow series with green edges that were produced from the 1930s to the 1970s.
The model was created using Blender and Substance Painter. Preview images were rendered with Iray.
Polygon Count
1154 vertices
1184 faces
2304 triangles  
File Formats
Autodesk FBX (.fbx)
OBJ (.obj)
Collada (.dae)
Blender v2.79 (.blend)  
Materials & Textures
The model is UV-mapped and has a single material with a set of physics based textures (PBR MetalRough workflow).  
The textures are not baked into the model, but are saved as png-files with a resolution of 2048 x 2048 pixels (8 bits) in the zip-file PBR textures:  
Rusty mug_Enameled metal_BaseColor.png
Rusty mug_Enameled metal_Height.png
Rusty mug_Enameled metal_Metallic.png

description_text:
Game ready low-poly Electric Kettle model in 2 colors with PBR textures for game engines/renderers.
This product is intended for game/real time/background use. This model is not intended for subdivision. Renders done in Marmoset Toolbag 3. Default render in Blender will NOT look like the preview images. The Marmoset Toolbag scene is included.
The textures in the embedded Marmoset preview are somewhat compressed. The textures you get when you purchase this product have better quality.
||SPECS||

  - Geometry is triangulated to ensure best shading.

  - Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space.

  - All materials and objects named appropriately.

  - Scaled to approximate real world size.

  - Tested in Marmoset Toolbag 3(see renders).

  - Tested in Unreal Engine 4.

  - Tested in Unity Engine.

  - Unity and Unreal Engine 4 projects included.

  - No special plugins needed.

  - .dae, .abc, .stl, .obj and .fbx versions exported from Blender 2.82.

|| Textures ||
4096x4096 textures

  - General PBR Metallic/Roughness  textures: BaseColor, Metallic, Roughness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO.

  - Unity Textures: Albedo, MetallicSmoothness, Normal(OpenGL), AO.

  - Unreal Engine 4 textures: BaseColor, OcclusionRoughnessMetallic, Normal(DirectX).

  - PBR Specular/Glossiness textures: Diffuse, Specular, Glossiness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO.

All textures in png format. Substance Painter source files also available in the extra downloads so that you can easily alter the textures as you wish with Substance Painter.

description_text:
Set of 7 different frying pans for kitchen archiviz. The set contains:

  - oldschool pan with edgy handle

  - modern all-pupose pan

  - poached eggs pan with 3 dimples

  - low edge pan for frying crepes and pancakes

  - a deep wok for asian cuisine

  - a rounded square shaped grill pan with several fins

  - a saucepan (pot) with metal cover

These models dont need any texture files, as all the shaders are procedural. You can adjust the subdivision level if you don't need a high poly model.

description_text:
3D Model Set of:

  - 
a 7 Piece Set of Cutlery consisting of

  -  a little, normal and big Fork (5762 | 14489 | 11682)

  -  a little and normal butter-knife (3810 | 5376)

  - a little and normal Spoon (3810 | 5367)

This Model was tested and made to work with Blenders Cycles Engine all previews and examples are given from there.
Thank You for reading this and considering to use my 3D Model :)

description_text:
Chest freezer. This asset is game ready, uses as few polygons and vertices where possible, omitting polygons when not seen e.g underneath and the back.
Model has been built to real world scale.

  - 
File Formats: unitypackage, FBX, OBJ

  - 
Animation: Lid opens and shuts

  - 
Asset ID: ls-pr-chest-freezer-a

  - 
Polygons: 26

  - 
Vertices: 28

  - 
UV Mapping: Yes. Has a single UV Map Channel.

  - 
Unwrapped UVS: Non-overlapping

  - Low Poly(game-ready)

  - 
Textures: Albedo, Ambient Occlusion, Metallic/Glossiness/Reflection, Normal 

  - 
Max Texture Size Included: 2048 x 2048 @ 5.12 px/cm texel density

  - 
Optimal Texture Size (Ideal for performance): 1024 x 1024 @ 2.56 px/cm texel density. See the Default tab on each Unity texture for optimal sizes.

Unity: Exported as a Unity Package, with URP. This can easily be converted to HDRP with Unity via Edit > Render Pipeline > HD Render Pipeline > Upgrade Project Materials. An animation controller with parameters has already been setup for your convenience, along with the Animation clips if applicable. Generate Lightmaps UV’s is on and 1 Unity unit = 1 metre.
Other game engines / applications: The FBX files and textures can easily be used with the Unreal Engine or 3D applications which support FBX. The models use few materials and textures and should be easy to create your own materials and assign the textures. Animation frames are also included if applicable.

description_text:
A kitchen scale prop. Blue in colour, circular, 18.5cm in diameter, and 1.6cm thick.
Geometry:

  - Tris and quads only, not subdividable.

  - Smooth shading with some custom edge normals for sharper edges.

  - Modelled to real-world scale, units: metres

  - Object is composed of two separate watertight meshes - the base and the glass surface. A small air gap is left between both meshes to allow for more realistic refraction and prevent potential z-fighting. 

Texturing:

  - PBR textures, Color, normal, specular, roughness, transparency. 

  - 2048*2048 resolution (2K)

  - png format

  - Entirely UV mapped with no overlap. 

Created in Blender. .blend file has textures packed (embedded in the file).
